## Organization / project

Who is adopting it, and what the packs are for.

## Scale

How many repos would carry a `packs/` directory? Roughly how many packs total?

## What you need from the spec

Governance as packs, a conformance CI gate, a new profile, a migration path - whatever your case actually needs. Concrete asks get concrete answers.

## Timeline

If there is a deadline or a migration window, say so; it shapes the advice.
